# Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health

> > Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health (BSPH) is a leading institution in public health education, research, and practice, advancing health equity and innovation worldwide.

The Bloomberg School of Public Health at Johns Hopkins University is the oldest and largest school of public health in the world. This web help desk provides technical support and resources for managing the school's Drupal-based website infrastructure, ensuring accessibility compliance, and maintaining digital communications platforms.

## Key Topics

- BSPH (Bloomberg School of Public Health)
- Johns Hopkins University
- Public health education and research
- Drupal CMS
- Web accessibility standards
- Faculty profiles and directories
- Multimedia resources
- Google Analytics
- PhotoShelter
- StaffBase
- Website support and help desk
- Email management
- Knowledge base resources

## Website Support & Help Desk

- [BSPH Website Help Desk](https://webhelp.publichealth.jhu.edu/): Central support portal for BSPH website management, including Drupal CMS assistance, accessibility compliance, faculty profile management, multimedia resources, and web platform troubleshooting
